Hi team,

Quick post-mortem / action items from today’s AI Stream Summit session (Redwood keynote + AMA):

What I’m attaching:
- aisummit_attendees_20260308.csv (CSV: name, company, title, email, Q&A flag, session_engagement)
- mql_routing_sheet_20260309.xlsx (lead-scoring + suggested owner)
- routing_rules.md (short doc w/ thresholds I used)

High-level segmentation I ran:
- High intent (attended + asked question + demo-watch > 60%): 48 leads — recommend SDR outbound within 24–48h.
- Product interest (watched demo, requested pricing info): 22 leads — AE outreach required, aim for 72h.
- Nurture (watched recording or registered but no engagement): 420 — Marketing cadence + replay + resource pack.

Proposed immediate routing (please confirm by EOD):
- Connor: take the 48 high-intent MQLs (HubSpot list ID 78012). Prioritize those who requested a live demo in Q&A.
- Rachel: take the 22 product-interest leads for AE qualification and initial discovery.
- Marissa: run nurture sequence with replay + blog + CTAs starting tomorrow.

Replay link + collateral: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AIsummitReplay (sharing set to anyone with link).

Notes on hygiene: I de-duped emails, removed internal-only addresses, and added a column for session timestamp. The scoring thresholds are in routing_rules.md — I used conservative cutoffs so we don’t spam low-engagement folks.

Next steps: Connor/Rachel — please confirm ownership and add notes in HubSpot. Marissa — request creative if you need a shorter 2-minute clip.

Thanks — great turnout (~1.6k registrants; ~520 attendees live).

—
